sections.heading: Trivia
sections.text:
The vest is modeled after a FirstSpear Siege-R Optimized Vest equipped with the company's Modular Armor Scalable System (M.A.S.S.) accessories. The configuration shown in-game incorporates several commercially available FirstSpear components, including:
- FirstSpear Siege-R Optimized Vest base
- FirstSpear M.A.S.S. Shoulder Straps with FirstSpear M.A.S.S. Shoulder Pads
- FirstSpear M.A.S.S. Biceps
- FirstSpear M.A.S.S. Throat Guard and FirstSpear Collar Protector
  - Both are notably inscribed with the word "LegenD".

- Three FirstSpear Ragnar MultiMag Rapid Adjust Pockets, containing two double-stacked Glock 9x19 17-round magazines and two AR-15 5.56x45 Magpul PMAG 30 GEN M3 W STANAG 30-round magazines
- FirstSpear Handcuff Pouch in Ranger Green
- FirstSpear Groin Protector.

Mounted to the carrier are an Imminent Threat Solutions (ITS) Fatboy Trauma Pouch, Crye Precision GP Pouch 11×6×4, MPU5 networking radio in a Juggernaut Case Radio Holster, Thyrm CellVault-5M, S&S Precision V-Lite, North American Rescue (NAR) CAT TQ pouch, and a pair of Patrol Incident Gear (PIG) FDT gloves retained by an S-biner.

This Russian poem can be found on the groin protector:
"В пучине водной, сквозь тонкий лёд,
Он, задыхаясь, шёл на дно.
В предсмертной судороге безмолвной
Спасал он друга всё равно."

It translates to:
"In the depths of the water, through the thin ice,
He sank to the bottom, gasping for breath.
In a silent death throe,
He still managed to save his friend."
